correctness.rationale: Complete algebraic proof for each integer \(k\ge2\), \(x>0\) and \(h\ge0\). The Laplacian decomposes into a three-dimensional quotient and (k−1) scalar leaf-difference modes. The four exhaustive off-diagonal entries have displayed exact rational formulas over a positive spectral denominator; the diagonals are positive because the scalar [2/2] Padé response is positive on nonnegative eigenvalues. Sign analysis gives the two unique quadratic horizons, and a positive remainder at the lower horizon rules out an earlier ordinary-pair sign change. A symbolic checker and 90 exact direct rational matrices replayed without errors (2886 exact identities).

value.rationale: The underlying quantity is endpoint positivity of a standard fourth-order method for a minimal heterogeneous hub-and-spoke diffusion/Markov network. The theorem is a natural all-parameter classification, not an arbitrary slice: it identifies the complete feasible conductance interval, exact maximal safe timestep outside it, and a second distinct physical sign-loss event. The degree-dependent strong-spoke tolerance versus degree-independent weak-spoke threshold supplies actionable discretization robustness information absent from broad sufficient conditions.
